rationale: The bid-ask spread of ~109 bps substantially exceeds the 5-minute ATR of $0.05, meaning transaction costs alone would consume most of any realistic move, making profitable entry in either direction structurally difficult. Price is already at 88% of today's range with no news catalyst and the most recent high-volume candle (8,238 shares) produced a wick down to $12.71 before recovering, suggesting absorption at highs rather than a clean breakout. Without a clear directional edge and with liquidity costs this punishing relative to the measured volatility, skipping is the appropriate action.
